title: ALTER THE SHIRT. ENTER THE RACE.
passages: I was cutting collars and sleeves off linen shirts, making clothes feel closer to what I actually wanted to wear. That same willingness to intervene in my own experience showed up on the water.

At the Pilot Regatta, I joined Tamarack's crew, asked endless questions, and worked the bow. We brought home third place. I was the new person learning from people who knew more. Again. The pattern was becoming clear: find something compelling, find the people, ask the questions, and join in.
